settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHint: Invoices can be printed in a different language from the app.
settings.businessHint: Printed on invoices. GSTIN and state decide how tax is charged.
settings.registrationHint: Composition and unregistered businesses issue a bill of supply without GST.

settings.seriesHint: Invoice, purchase and receipt numbering per financial year
